Reserved Model Student (Korean: ) is Bunny Bun's second Costume, released during the Galactic Empire's March to Glory! update, as part of the CookieRun: Crumble Launch Event! collaboration event to celebrate Cookie Run: Crumble's release. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained by reaching Stage 10-1 in Cookie Run: Crumble.

Story

Bunny Bun gives off an unapproachable aura as the students hustle and bustle, rushing through the school gates in an attempt to not be late for class. It quickly picks out inappropriate school uniforms, missing name tags, and even the slightest bit of tardiness, blocking all possibilities for negotiation with its black mask. Rather than causing fear in its fellow students, this Pet's unwavering demeanor has made more and more students admire the student council. Under this model student's watch, school remains orderly for yet another day.

Trivia

  • Reserved Model Student was released alongside  Student Council Delinquent.
  • Reserved Model Student features Bunny Bun wearing Dark Cherry Cookie's face mask.

Venomwing Butterfly (Korean: 검은 독나비, gomeun dongnabi) is Bunny Bun's first Costume, released in the second half of The Legend of the Spirit Weapons update. It is an Epic Costume that can only be obtained through a Pet Costume package in the Package Shop.

Story

Follow the sweet aroma, and you might find yourself in the kitchens of the Cult of the Umbral Pact. But beware... Bunny Bun's dumplings are always laced with poison, whether served to the righteous or the wicked. It's no wonder Bunny Bun's name is whispered with the same infamy as White Peach Cookie's. Still, rest assured, those truly cherished are given only the sweetest, safest treats.

Trivia

  • Venomwing Butterfly was released alongside  Venomcrafting Vicar,  Nimble Delivery Dasher, and  Head Dumpling Chef.
